# Comfy VEED Clean Audio- Video Speech Cleanup

Clean the speech inside a video with VEED Clean Audio: background noise, music and effects are stripped from the soundtrack, pauses are cleaned completely, and the clip comes back with 48 kHz mono speech, optionally normalized to a target loudness while the picture stays as shot. Video up to 1799 seconds. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_veed_clean_audio_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
